tuning.title: Tuning report
tuning.window.suggested: Suggested test windows (loop in manual, output moved)
tuning.window.none: No test window found: the loop was never in manual with output moves. The whole record is used; the result may be unreliable.
tuning.fit.good: The model fits the data well (R² {r2}).
tuning.fit.fair: The model fits moderately (R² {r2}); treat the settings with care.
tuning.fit.poor: The model fits poorly (R² {r2}); do not rely on these settings.
tuning.warning.closed_loop_data: The window contains closed-loop (auto) data, so the model can be biased. Prefer a step test with the loop in manual.
tuning.blocked.stiction: Retuning is blocked: stiction suspected. Repair the valve first.
tuning.blocked.model_failed: No model could be identified on this window. Choose another window.
tuning.blocked.poor_fit: The model fits this window poorly, so the settings are withheld. Choose a window with a clearer step.
tuning.check.xLabel: seconds since the start of the dataset
tuning.preview: Predicted response to a setpoint step (on the identified model, not on the plant)
tuning.dcs: The same settings in DCS parameter forms
tuning.dcs.proportional_band_minutes: Proportional band, integral time in minutes
tuning.readOnly: Nothing is written to the plant.
benefit.title: Benefit report
benefit.disclaimer: This number is an estimate. It shows what lower variability could be worth if the freed room can really be used; that needs a trial.
benefit.limit.default: No limit given: placeholder {value} {unit}. Enter the real limit.
benefit.value: Value of one unit for one hour
benefit.reduction: Variability cut (share of the standard deviation removed)
benefit.gap: Gap between the mean and the limit now
benefit.note.beyond_limit: The mean is already beyond the limit.
benefit.note.near_limit: The limit is already violated or nearly so at the current variability.
benefit.note.no_value: No value per unit given, so no money is shown.
benefit.chart: PV distribution now and after the variability cut (sketch with normal curves)

fuzzy.versions.title: Versions

fuzzy.versions.compare: Compare the current rules with the version
fuzzy.advisory: Advisory only: nothing is written to the plant.
fuzzy.term.invalid: These parameters are not in increasing order.
fuzzy.whatif.hint: Move the sliders to see which rules fire and what the system would do.
fuzzy.output.none: No rule fires, so there is no output.
fuzzy.replay.hint: Shows what this rule base would have said over the recorded period.
